name: Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) Pattern
description: An acute respiratory infection constellation characterized by fever, cough, and generalized constitutional symptoms such as myalgia, fatigue, and rapid onset.
differential_considerations: Common Cold (usually lacks high fever and severe myalgias)

name: Acute Viral Upper Respiratory Infection (Common Cold) Pattern
description: A mild, self-limited viral infection of the upper respiratory tract primarily manifesting as nasal congestion, sore throat, sneezing, and low-grade or absent fever.
differential_considerations: Acute Streptococcal Pharyngitis (severe sore throat, exudates, high fever)

name: Allergic Rhinitis Pattern
description: An IgE-mediated inflammatory response of the nasal mucosa triggered by allergen exposure, characterized by sneezing, clear rhinorrhea, and ocular/nasal pruritus without fever.
differential_considerations: Early Viral Upper Respiratory Tract Infection

name: Migraine-Type Headache Pattern
description: A neurovascular primary headache disorder marked by recurrent, throbbing, typically unilateral head pain associated with sensory hypersensitivities (photophobia, phonophobia) and autonomic features (nausea).
clinical_features: Unilateral throbbing or pulsating cranial pain

name: Acute Gastroenteritis Pattern
description: Acute inflammation of the mucous membranes of the stomach and intestines resulting in rapid-onset watery diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal cramping.
differential_considerations: Appendicitis / Acute Abdomen (severe focal right lower quadrant pain)

name: Uncomplicated Lower Urinary Tract Infection (Cystitis) Pattern
description: Bacterial colonization and inflammation localized to the bladder and urethra presenting with irritative voiding symptoms without flank pain or systemic fever.

name: Suspected Upper Urinary Tract Infection / Pyelonephritis Pattern
description: Ascending urinary infection extending into the renal parenchyma characterized by lower urinary tract symptoms accompanied by flank pain and systemic fever.
differential_considerations: Lower UTI with Musculoskeletal Back Pain

name: Severe Influenza-Like Illness with High Constitutional Burden
description: A higher-severity subset of influenza-like syndrome characterized by very high fever, severe myalgia, and marked prostration.

name: COVID-19 Respiratory Infection Pattern
description: Acute viral respiratory illness characterized by systemic fever, cough, fatigue, and pathognomonic sudden sensory impairment (loss of taste or smell).
clinical_features: Sudden loss of taste or smell (Anosmia / Ageusia)

name: Acute Streptococcal Pharyngitis (Strep Throat) Pattern
description: Acute bacterial infection of the pharynx caused by Streptococcus pyogenes, marked by sudden severe sore throat, tonsillar exudates, cervical lymphadenopathy, and absence of cough (Centor criteria).
clinical_features: Severe sore throat with painful swallowing

name: Acute Rhinosinusitis (Sinus Infection) Pattern
description: Inflammation of the paranasal sinuses presenting with facial pressure or pain over the cheeks/forehead, purulent nasal discharge, and severe nasal obstruction.

name: Acute Bronchitis (Lower Airway Inflammation) Pattern
description: Self-limiting inflammation of the large airways following an upper respiratory infection, dominated by persistent cough with sputum production.
clinical_features: Chest burning or discomfort with coughing

name: Acute Bronchospasm / Asthma Exacerbation Pattern
description: Reversible lower airway obstruction manifested by expiratory wheezing, chest tightness, shortness of breath, and cough.

name: Tension-Type Headache Pattern
description: The most prevalent primary headache disorder, presenting as a bilateral, non-pulsating, pressing or tight band-like headache associated with neck muscle tenderness.

name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) Pattern
description: Retrograde movement of gastric contents into the esophagus causing retrosternal burning pain (heartburn) and acid regurgitation, classically exacerbated postprandially and when supine.
clinical_features: Acid regurgitation / sour taste in mouth
Worsened by lying down or bending over
Absence of cardiac exertional red flags
differential_considerations: Cardiac Chest Pain (Angina / ACS - MUST BE RULED OUT)

name: Acute Otitis Media (Middle Ear Infection) Pattern
description: Rapid onset of infection and inflammation within the middle ear space, usually occurring as a secondary complication of viral upper respiratory tract congestion.
clinical_features: Sensation of ear fullness or diminished hearing

name: Acute Allergic Conjunctivitis Pattern
description: Bilateral allergic inflammation of the ocular conjunctiva characterized by prominent itching, conjunctival redness, and tearing without purulent discharge.

name: Acute Invasive / Inflammatory Enteritis (Dysentery) Pattern
description: Bacterial or amoebic invasion of the intestinal mucosa causing inflammatory diarrhea characterized by visible blood in stool, severe cramps, and high fever.
